paper_title: Ultralight Dark Matter Search with Space-Time Separated Atomic Clocks and Cavities
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_me (approximate flat bound read from Fig. 2)
notes: Paper presents first constraints on scalar-DM coupling to electron mass d_me alone in mass range 1e-19 to 2e-15 eV, using two analyses: NPL/PTB cavity-cavity fiber comparison (spatial term) and GPS microwave clocks vs H-maser (temporal term). Signal amplitude is stated to be independent of DM mass, so the constraints are approximately flat (horizontal) across the mass range. Assumed local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Numerical coupling values could not be read precisely from Fig. 2 (log10|dme| vs log10(m_phi/eV)); the emitted value ~1 is an order-of-magnitude placeholder and should be treated as approximate. 95% C.L.
